items.item: Uses a permission set (or a permission set group) with field-level security, not a profile edit
items.evidence: Only proposes it and asks: "I'd suggest a new permission set, `Sales_Commission_Access`... Do you want that, or should I change the Sales profile instead?" Nothing is written.

items.item: Grants only what is needed (read vs edit)
items.evidence: Contradicts itself: the permission set is suggested with "read and edit", then "I'd default to read-only unless Sales needs to edit it." No access is actually granted.
